artworks.title: David is Welcomed after Killing Goliath, and Saul's Jealousy
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a procession scene. The drawing depicts a large group of people gathered in a cityscape, participating in a procession. Various figures are shown in the foreground, some wearing classical robes, while others are wearing armor. In the background, distant landscapes and possibly military elements, such as soldiers with weapons, are visible. The city setting is marked by architectural elements like arches and a tower with reliefs. Engraved text at the bottom suggests a narrative complementing the scene.

artworks.title: Moses Returns to Egypt from Midian
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a biblical scene depicting two figures walking alongside a donkey through a landscape. One figure is leading the donkey while the other is following. The donkey is carrying a basket with two small figures inside. In the background, a city with towers and domes on hills is visible. The foreground includes leafless trees. An inscription in Gothic script is located below the image.

artworks.title: The Angel Agitating the Pool of Bethesda
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene with architectural columns and figures, including a winged figure. The image depicts an architectural setting featuring a series of columns and arches. There are figures interacting with each other and a swirling pool or body of water. The figures are detailed with flowing garments and dramatic gestures, indicative of a narrative or mythological scene. Beneath the image, there is German text.

artworks.title: Elijah Anoints Elisha
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a rural scene with a plow being guided by oxen in front of a building. Two oxen are harnessed to a plow in the foreground, which is being operated. One figure stands nearby holding a large item. In the background, there is a rustic house with steep roofing, trees, and small hills. The drawing includes text underneath resembling an explanatory legend. The style features clear, finely detailed lines typical of historical representations or etchings.

artworks.title: Queen of Sheba's Visit to Solomon
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a king seated on a throne in a detailed interior setting. The central figure, with a crown and a long beard, gestures while surrounded by other figures displaying rich drapery. The throne is ornate with lions depicted on the armrests, and in front of it are various vessels. Below the image, there are inscriptions in German.

artworks.title: The Rival Sacrifices of Elijah and the Priests of Baal
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a religious ritual with an animal sacrifice on an altar. The artwork depicts a scene where a central figure is kneeling with arms raised towards an altar, upon which lies a burning sacrificial animal. Flames and smoke rise from the altar. To the right stand a group of onlookers observing the ritual. In the background, more figures are engaged in similar sacrificial activities around another altar. The drawing includes text below the image, which appears to be in German. The composition is detailed, with fine lines indicating the figures' garb and the texture of the landscape.

artworks.title: The Murder of the Children of Bethel
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a biblical scene involving a city, several figures, and two bears. The scene portrays a bearded man gesturing towards three figures resembling children or youths in motion. In the background, there is a cityscape with several buildings and a dome visible through an archway. Two bears are seen behind the figures, one indicating aggressive behavior. The surroundings include trees, a path to a city, and a mountainous landscape. The lower portion features an inscription in an old dialect.

artworks.title: Elijah is Taken up to Heaven
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a chariot surrounded by flames. The chariot is being drawn by two horses with fiery manes, emitting swirling flames and smoke. In the chariot, there is a robed figure holding onto another standing figure in front. The chariot is detailed with ornate wheels. The background is simple, focusing on the central figures and the chariot. Below the image is a section of text in German.

artworks.title: Elisha Raises the Son of the Shunammite
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a biblical scene. The image shows several figures in an ancient setting with detailed attire reminiscent of biblical times. The background features a building with a slanted roof and a small window. Two groups of figures are depicted. In the foreground, one group appears to be gesturing or conversing with a figure outside the building. In the background, another pair of figures stands near a bed. Additional details include a table with vessels and a landscape extending beyond the setting. The style of the drawing, with intricate lines and shading, suggests a historical or religious narrative.

artworks.title: Naaman is Cured of Leprosy
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a historical scene featuring various figures in classical attire beside a body of water. The drawing illustrates several individuals dressed in classical or Roman military clothing, with one figure kneeling by a stream. A chariot pulled by horses is visible in the background, along with architectural elements resembling ancient temples or buildings.

artworks.title: Elisha Punishes Gehazi with Naaman's Leprosy
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a biblical scene. The drawing shows two figures prominently in the foreground: one is an older bearded man wearing a long robe, while the other is a smaller figure bowing and holding a garment or object. In the background, there are several figures near a chariot drawn by two horses. The landscape includes small hills and a distant building. Below the scene is a block of text in an old script.

artworks.title: Isaiah Accepts Mockery because of His Faith
artworks.description: This is a drawing of four figures in a scuffle with a distant structure in the background. The drawing depicts a group of four figures. The figures are rendered in a dynamic composition, with intricate detailing in their postures and expressions. In the background, there is a landscape with a distant building resting atop a hill, flanked by trees and clouds. The bottom includes text in German, featuring a biblical scripture reference and some passages. The etching style with fine lines suggests a classic technique employed in historical illustrations.

artworks.title: The Victory of Judas Maccabeus Over Niccanor
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene involving an ancient battle or destruction. Two central figures, one dressed as a soldier with a helmet and armor and the other as an elderly man with a cloak, are in the middle of an interaction. Groups of kneeling figures surround them, with a city or fortress in ruins in the background. Soldiers on horseback and other figures are positioned further back, and there is text in a stylized script below the scene.

artworks.title: Daniel in the Lions' Den
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a man surrounded by lions in a den. The man is kneeling and looking up with his hands in prayer. Above him, three figures are standing. The background shows a bright sun shining. The drawing is framed with detailed etching typical of historical religious artworks. Below the illustration, there is text providing context for the scene.

artworks.title: Jonah in the Whale
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a ship on a stormy sea. The ship is shown with full sails and visible passengers struggling against turbulent waves. A large sea creature is approaching from the lower right of the composition. The waves are artistically rendered in sweeping lines. Below the artwork is a section of text in German.

artworks.title: Jonah is Delivered from the Whale
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a man emerging from a large fish near the shore. The scene shows the figure pulling themselves out of the mouth of the fish onto land, gripping onto a tree for support. The sea is depicted with flowing lines, and there is a spout of water in the background, implying motion. The drawing includes a text at the bottom in a classical style. The use of line work emphasizes the muscular structure of the figure and the texture of the sea and trees, indicating a narrative moment captured with a sense of movement and drama.

artworks.title: Joab Betrays Abner
artworks.description: Two men are shown in the foreground of the image. They are standing close together, with one man holding the other by the shoulders. Both men have facial hair and are wearing armor and tunics. One man is holding a sword in his left hand. Surrounding them are rock formations and trees. In the background, there is a group of armed soldiers partially obscured by the rocks. The ground is rocky with small stones scattered around. At the bottom of the image, there is a block of text in a script-like font.

artworks.title: The Men of Ephraim Care for their Captives and Return Them to Jerico
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a historical scene. The monochromatic illustration features multiple figures engaged in various activities, including armored soldiers and other individuals. The background architecture includes a large structure with arched windows and a detailed roof, with the distant landscape showing small buildings or settlements. Animals like a donkey and two dogs are also present. The drawing is enhanced by intricate line work and hatching for shading and depth. The text below is written in German.

artworks.title: The Three Kings Tell Herod of Christ's Birth
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a biblical scene with figures interacting indoors. There are regal-looking individuals in robes and head bindings, engaging in discussion or proclamation. One figure points towards the sky, where a star is depicted. Surrounding them are architectural elements and figures with camels in the background. The clothing and expressions suggest a historical or narrative context. Below the drawing, a passage in old script offers context to the scene.

artworks.title: The Adoration of the Magi
artworks.description: This is a woodcut or illustrated print from 1548 depicting a scene of figures adoring a child and a woman. Figures are kneeling and presenting gifts, while a cow and a donkey are visible in the background. The setting appears to be a stable with arches and a thatched roof. More figures are gathered around, suggesting an audience.

artworks.title: The Flight into Egypt
artworks.description: This drawing shows a horse with a seated figure and a smaller figure, accompanied by a robed figure walking next to them. The background features hills, trees, and a wintery path. The larger figure holds the smaller one on their lap, indicating movement. The robed figure carries a staff. The figures and landscape are detailed with shading and texture. There is German text at the bottom.

artworks.title: The Holy Family Returns from Egypt
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a traveler leading a donkey with a figure riding it through a rustic landscape. The drawing is detailed with cross-hatching to create depth and texture. The background features architectural elements. The foreground shows a simplistic terrain with lines suggesting a path or road. Below the image, there is a section containing text in Old German script. The detailed line work creates a sense of motion and storytelling typical of period illustrations.

artworks.title: The Baptism of Christ
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a baptism scene. The drawing shows a religious ceremony in a river setting. One figure is baptizing another, with a divine presence above. In the background, a third figure observes. The scene is enhanced with a celestial figure emerging from the clouds, along with a dove. The landscape features sparse trees and gently flowing water. Below the image, there is a banner with text in a gothic script.

artworks.title: The Parable of the Wicked Husbandmen
artworks.description: This is a black and white illustration of a vineyard with figures working and a building in the background. The outdoor scene shows rows of trellised vines. In the foreground, several figures are engaged in labor, with one figure lying on the ground. Additional figures are shown in the middle left. The background includes a cylindrical tower structure and smaller buildings. There is German text below the image. The artwork is detailed, with careful attention to the linear forms of the vines and the architectural features.
